![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Normalize the fixtures array using `asArray` and filter out non-record entries before performing property-based filtering or aggregation to prevent TypeErrors.

```javascript
function boundaryReceipt({ selfAssessmentCopilotBoundary, frontendFixtures }) {
  const fixtures = asArray(frontendFixtures?.fixtures).filter(isRecord);
  const sideEffects = selfAssessmentCopilotBoundary?.side_effect_receipt ?? {};
  const runtime = selfAssessmentCopilotBoundary?.runtime_execution_boundary ?? {};
  return {
    self_assessment_secure_exam_ready_uplift_count:
      fixtures.filter((fixture) => (
        fixture.self_assessment?.can_raise_secure_or_exam_ready === true
      )).length + (
        selfAssessmentCopilotBoundary?.self_assessment_learning_effect
          ?.can_raise_secure_or_exam_ready === true ? 1 : 0
      ),
    copilot_ocr_vlm_external_model_execution_count:
      Number(sideEffects.ocr_or_vlm_call_count ?? 0) +
      Number(sideEffects.external_model_call_count ?? 0) +
      Number(sideEffects.runtime_copilot_answer_generation_count ?? 0) +
      (runtime.ocr_or_vlm_execution_allowed === true ? 1 : 0),
    automatic_scoring_claim_count:
      Number(frontendFixtures?.summary?.automatic_scoring_claim_count ?? 0),
    smart_mark_readiness_claim_count:
      Number(frontendFixtures?.summary?.smart_mark_production_ready_fixture_count ?? 0) +
      Number(sideEffects.smart_mark_readiness_mutation_count ?? 0),
    raw_ms_text_storage_count:
      Number(frontendFixtures?.summary?.raw_ms_text_storage_fixture_count ?? 0) +
      Number(sideEffects.raw_ms_text_storage_count ?? 0),
  };
}
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When processing collections of assets or inputs, normalize the input using an array helper (e.g., `asArray`) and filter out non-record entries before mapping or flat-mapping over them to prevent TypeErrors on null, undefined, or non-array inputs.
</details>
Fixed in de22655e5. `resourceAccessReceipt` now normalizes asset and fixture collections with `asArray(...).filter(isRecord)` and guards `fixture_id` before checking pre-attempt exposure.
Fixed in de22655e5. `frontendFixtureQueryReceipt` preserves the raw fixture count while filtering to record entries before mapping/queryability checks.
Fixed in de22655e5. The validator now checks `source_artifacts` type, requires all expected source artifact roles, emits explicit diagnostics, and fails closed when roles are missing.
Fixed in de22655e5. Added fail-closed regression coverage for null, non-record, malformed receipts, invalid `source_artifacts`, missing expected roles, and malformed collection entries.
Fixed in de22655e5. `allowedPathQueryReceipt` now filters rows, reveal states, and fixtures to records, and only indexes non-empty string IDs/states.
Fixed in de22655e5. `boundaryReceipt` now normalizes fixtures with `asArray(...).filter(isRecord)` before property-based aggregation.
Fixed in de22655e5. `buildRehearsalSummary` now preserves raw collection counts and uses record-only arrays for all property-based aggregation.
